item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • 発売日: 2000-11-24
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: SMノススメ -The Seeker ZERO-
  • 英語名: SM no Susume -The Seeker ZERO-

あらすじ

Satsuki finally confesses to her big brother Taiki that she is in love with him. However, Taiki is a full-fledged sadist! Notwithstanding, Satsuki refuses to let go of her feelings for her brother; with some confusion, she accepts his inclinations.

At about that time, Taiki’s junior from high school, Kaoru Sakuraba, and Satsuki’s senior, Taeka Yukimoto come to stay with them. All three these girls are infatuated with Taiki. They all offer to begin training to become his girl-slaves. And so, the training in their new profession begins…

别名

  • ウェーバー ～Ｔｈｅ Ｓｅｅｋｅｒ ２～ Perfect Edition

あらすじ

A guy and his girlfriend got lost. Their new navigation software: Seeker got them to a mansion. There, they are invited to stay the night, and a few more days the next morning after meeting the lady owner. They explored the house a bit, finding some strange things. Soon, the girlfriend is missing. He looked for her and found more strange people of the house. He can decide to join their fun or not. This weird mansion is not for most people. This game has few choices, but will get you to one of the 7 endings depending on how nasty you are.

item.title: Yanyan no Gekitou Dousoukai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tenshindou
  • 発売日: 1995-05-27
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: やんやんの激闘同窓会
  • 英語名: Yanyan no Gekitou Dousoukai

あらすじ

The mascot character of Tenshindo, “Yanyan,” is back in the lead role, along with the characters of Marshall Age, Jinn Eien no Yuushi, and Goice, who were selected based on questionnaire postcards!

A fierce battle unfolds between more than 20 characters, including nostalgic characters and characters who have never had an H scene!

The girls have received an invitation to participate in the “Fierce Card Game Battle Royal” by the mysterious Y, and are gathering to fight for the title of “The Queen of Tenshindo”.

item.description:

  • 発売日: 1994-12-15
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ゴイス
  • 英語名: Goice

别名

  • Greatest of interactive Cinematype entertainment-software

あらすじ

Goice contains three episodes, which tell three separate stories, but share the same villains: human-looking aliens under the command of the insane female captain Storm, and an army of mechanical dolls they use to kidnap and rape young girls from the Earth.

The first episode focuses on two girls, Harue and Kyoko, who survive a car crash caused by the appearance of a giant foll that attacks the city in a Godzilla fashion, only to be captured by an army of smaller once, brought to Strom’s space ship, and raped in various ways.

item.title: Martial Age
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tenshindou
  • 発売日: 1992-03-27
  • スコア: 6.11/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: マーシャルエイジ
  • 英語名: Martial Age

あらすじ

Masahito is a Japanese teenager who studies martial arts. However, instead of studying, he prefers to chase pretty girls. Finally, after a quarrel with his father, Masahito leaves his home. Accidentally, he bumps into Keiko Yashima, the principal of Yuai girls school. She tests Masahito in combat, and against all rules, accepts him as the only male student in the school. Naturally, our hero uses this opportunity to “get lucky” with his all-female school mates…
